propositions: Lifecycle intent changes (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity) must be modeled as versioned intents with version equal to enclosing Observation.version, carrying no independent counter.
Create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be encoded as explicit inter-ticket dependencies that yield deferred dispositions with reason dependency_deferred when blocked.

Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limit decisions must be applied during pre-effect planning before any lifecycle intent or remote effect eligibility, with distinct deferral reasons (scope_deferred, safety_aborted, or skipped).
Ticket-sourced tombstone, pending/index-lag, moved-key, impossible-link, and partial-snapshot cases must map to deterministic skipped dispositions.
The plan_pass function must derive intents and dependencies and perform pre-effect exclusion with reason tagging while remaining pure (zero I/O, no repository/provider writes).

run_differs.py shadow construction at line 285 must adopt the updated plan_pass signature and pre-effect selection/filter/mode-cap/limit behavior without rendering preview output or performing effectful execution.
